author: Y Combinator
description:
In some cities, getting a building permit takes longer than building the house.

AI can help with plan reviews, zoning checks, inspections, licensing, public records, and other work that still happens largely by hand. There are 19,000 cities in America. City Hall could be one of the biggest untouched markets for AI.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: AI for City Hall

author: Y Combinator
description:
LLMs have gotten much better at coding and math, but their writing increasingly sounds flat and robotic.

The same reward signals that improve coding and agentic work can flatten voice and style. That leaves room for models built specifically to write well and be enjoyable to talk to.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: LLMs That Write Well

author: Y Combinator
description:
General-purpose AI is getting incredibly capable, but many industrial problems don’t need a giant model that can do everything.

Specialized foundation models for manufacturing, energy, and biology could match or beat general models with a fraction of the compute, learning new tasks from little or no labeled data.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Vertical Foundation Models
